objective: 实现行为中性的 typed Container transition seam 与确定性 Stage A 证据

semantic_brief.summary: DesiredReality：每个 fresh observation 可被纯分类为 immutable transition evidence，现有控制流与 fail-closed 结果不变。ClaimUnderTest：typed seam 能表达七类 buyer，尤其 r5 的 premature parent return。
core_points: ExistingEvidence：69个变更前测试全绿；r5 seq28为fresh SettingsRoot且旧belief仍停在Display
AllowedChange：immutable model、pure classifier、trace/public projection、immutable stability result
ForbiddenChange：Stage A保持既有state ownership与控制流不变
AcceptanceEvidence：七buyer、r5、verified return、sibling、external与正常路径确定性测试全部通过
StopCondition：需要新mutable truth、authority/owner、strategy语义、NavigationGraph或scope外实质改动时停止上报Leader

change_principles: ContainerTransition必须是immutable evidence result；Kind严格为SAME_CONTAINER、ENTER_CHILD、VERIFIED_RETURN_TO_ACTIVE_PARENT、PREMATURE_RETURN_TO_ACTIVE_PARENT、KNOWN_NON_PARENT_TRANSITION、EXTERNAL_EXIT、UNKNOWN_TRANSITION，Disposition严格为批准spec的四值
classifier必须pure且deterministic，只描述fresh evidence与允许的state effect；不得授权recovery、action、completion、route、re-entry或sibling continuation
Stage A仅建立typed seam与追加式structured evidence；不得新增Agent latest-transition mutable field，最新transition只从immutable trace/history派生
把_lastStabilityExhaustionDetail可变字符串handoff替换为immutable operation result；全部既有non-location quiescence classification与terminal reason保持语义等价

r5必须在structured transition中表达FromObserved=Display、ToObserved=SettingsRoot、ActiveExecution=Display、ActiveParent=SettingsRoot、Kind=PREMATURE_RETURN_TO_ACTIVE_PARENT、Disposition=OBSERVED_EXECUTION_PRESERVED、Display incomplete reference，同时Stage A不得更新旧belief或改变fail-closed terminal
read projection必须是immutable copy/derived view，缺失AssetRef显式MISSING_ASSET，不解析reason string，不暴露live Container mutable reference
保留当前working tree中的DecisionRecord重命名与observability编辑，不得回退、覆盖或改写不相关用户改动
acceptance: targeted pure-classifier tests覆盖全部七种Kind与四种Disposition，已知destination不产生authorization，未知与external分支保留execution obligation
r5 deterministic replay证明typed transition准确表达SettingsRoot observed、Display execution、immediate parent、incomplete CompletenessRef和MISSING_ASSET，同时Agent仍按既有路径fail closed且Stage A旧belief/control flow不变
verified-return、sibling continuation与external-boundary现有测试保持通过，transition只增加diagnostic evidence且不选择next sibling
_lastStabilityExhaustionDetail字段被删除，immutable operation result保留left-container、reobserve-failed、budget-exhausted与旧terminal message语义
Agent public只读projection从immutable trace派生latest transition；无structured event时显式unavailable，不从Reason反推
新增测试、69个冻结基线测试与dotnet build src/UniClaw.Runtime.sln均通过，git diff仅包含scope.write且保留原有未提交编辑
forbidden: 禁止修改_activeContainer、parents、ancestry或visited的ownership/storage；这些只在Stage B迁移
禁止让Stage A接受unexpected observed location进入live WorldBelief；该行为只在Stage C购买
禁止自动pop/complete/re-enter/recover、自动选择sibling、改变return eligibility或放宽fail-closed
禁止新增mutable context/latest transition/completeness copy、owner、authority、FSM state或persistent state
禁止修改OpenSpec、docs、WorkItem、GoalEvidence、Recovery、Traversal、Container local completeness或scope.write之外文件
escalation: 若七类transition无法用批准词表与现有evidence ref诚实表达，返回BLOCKED_FOR_SPEC并列出缺口
若r5 typed evidence需要先改变belief/control flow、增加mutable state或复制completeness，返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若现有dirty edits与本任务产生不可安全合并的语义冲突，保留现场并返回Leader，不得回退他人修改
若测试揭示owner不明、strategy semantics变化或scope外生产改动，停止并给出Expected/Observed/Gap/FDP/Owner
